name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana 2.0
department: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
description: LPG connection scheme for eligible adult women from poor households meeting the prescribed criteria.
benefits: New LPG connection support under PMUY, subject to scheme conditions
documents: Ration card/state family-composition document or permitted declaration
application_steps: Choose an LPG distributor or use the official PMUY application route
Submit KYC and required household documents
